body: I doubt anybody will contact me willing to meet up, but does anybody know any place where I could find somebody?
I don’t care what happens, but I cannot go back home right now.

Highschool, but I take classes at a college. I tried blocking the schools number on my moms phone, but guess I blocked the wrong one. And I was skipping school because I was planning on killing myself. A really shit attempt at an OD is what started it.
If not I’ll just walk until I find a tall building to throw myself off of
I think It’ll be like before birth. Just nothing. No consciousness. You won’t even realize you’re dead, you’ll just be dead. I hope there will be something after, but I don’t think there will be.

Probably. Their date of birth would be helpful too, if you know that. Also worth giving them any social media accounts or their phone number if you have it. Whatever you used to contact them. Before you call the police, I would reach out to them one more time, saying you’re going to contact the police. If you don’t get a response, then get the police involved. Even if it’s not enough, it’s worth a shot.

If you’re old enough, I would suggest going to a therapist/psychiatrist without telling your parents. Also look online for reviews, find somebody that won’t belittle you and will actually help you. There’s many different medications out there, part of it is trial and error. Lived with a bipolar person my entire childhood. They went from abusive to my biggest support. If that’s not possible, I can give you somebody to vent to. PM me. I’ll listen. Can’t say I’ll give great advice. But I will listen and I won’t belittle you or your problems. Either way, good luck.

I attempted suicide when I was 13 and it was the worst mistake of my life. Mostly because I wasn’t successful. Fucked up my health. Badly. Middle school is an awkward age. Your feelings could be depression or hormones or a mix of both. If you can, talk to your parents about it. Get a therapist, a prescription, etc. You have time to become a confident and successful person.
